plugin.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
plugin.summary: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!

website.readmeExcerpt:
This was originally written by Master WillWolf76 as a gift for me. I have since taken it over since he doesn't play his account on Aether these days, mostly playing Dead By Daylight or PUBG. Discord Bot for Fashion Reporting: https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1058753294400491531
DIscord for Bot Issues or Help: https://discord.gg/CREQbkXYUv
Github for Fashion Report: https://github.com/TheRedheadedWitch/FashionReport
You can use the /invite or /Discord commands to get this info in any server that the Bot is running.
I re-wrote this from the ground up. There is still a lot of work that needs to be done, but they are all future upgrades that will come out in time. The core plugins is intact and operational. When you type /fashionreport or /fr, a window will open up that display the weekly fashion report. If it is in red, it is not updated for the week. To be updated, one person with the mod needs to talk to Masked Rose. Once someone does, the automatically polling of the database will update everyone. Polling happens on Tuesdays (new week) and Fridays (Dyes can be discovered). Once information is updated, polling shuts down until the next time period arrives. Clicking on a theme will allow you to see all the items for that slot that will fit the theme. I still need to code the icons being added (crafting, Wolf Marks, etc ...) but they are in the code ready to go visually. Also there an ABOUT section that goes into the details of how Fashion Report works. I have been doing this for years, and I could not find any detailed description of how the point system works. Some people have a general idea, but they don't know how or why. Like they know points start at 68 if you have 4 armor themed slots but 70 if you have 3 armor themed slot and 1 accessory. Most people could not tell you exactly what all the stamps mean, specifically the light blue one. So I took the time to really find out and this plugin is a result of those efforts. For the longest time I could look at someone and tell them how Masked Rose would judge them in points. A lot of people loved that, but I can't always be there in Gold Saucer doing that so here comes this plugin. S Future feature of this plugin is that when a player who opts to participate does get judged by Masked Rose, the data is saved to the database in a table that self wipes itself each week. The data is only the information collected from fashioncheck addon, which is your itemids, your glamourids, stains, etc ... this information is very helpful in finding the dyes faster. When a lot of this data is collected and analyzed together, you can narrow down and eliminate most dyes fast, even finding the dyes. Using this system manually, I was able to beat the group over at Reddit by hours. I was able to discover the dyes in under an hour by myself. Instead of one person doing it with a lot of free accounts, the idea is that all information is shared and viewed by all to get the dye information faster. It will also add any new fashion pieces that were not in the database, so it is self growing. The dye window hasn't been built yet, just the information gathering part. The Dye window will come in a future update, where you can see the fyes attempted for each slot and the results. Also in a future update, there will be a Dye Window for knowing dye groups (it's based on IconId surprisingly enough, there are 2 for each color and 9 color groups) and where you can acquire those dyes. Lastly, this plugin doesn't just populate the other players who use the plugin, it also populates my Discord Bot which generates Fashion Reports automatically each week. You can use the /fashionreport command to get the current week or use the week option to pick a random week from the past. The report generates the image right in Discord for you each time. I am working on an easy 80 system to go along with it. You can get the Discord Bot with the link above.
website.title: FashionReport
